decisions.reason: As a close-to-core dietary supplement with likely low carrying cost and no clear negative signal, we would keep this option open while demand becomes clearer.
This skin-and-hair supplement fits the existing consumer health portfolio and can remain on the market because the downside of waiting is limited for a large expanding firm.

The joint-health supplement is near the firm's established offer and still has enough unresolved market potential to justify continued presence despite somewhat weaker evidence than the stronger line extensions.
The immune supplement was presented as an innovative addition and, given its fit with the supplement line and modest option-holding cost, it is worth retaining.

This generic blood-pressure product is less aligned with the tested supplement expansion and the earlier quality-related problem reveals downside that makes further commitment unattractive under thin generic margins.
The OTC migraine triptan is more distant from the established offer, but as a relatively recent launch in a broadening portfolio it still merits another year before abandoning the option.
